newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu leaves Monaco hospital.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu leaves Monaco hospital.

text.p: Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko, facing a fast-spreading revolt back home, left a hospital in Monaco on Wednesday after undergoing cancer treatment, witnesses said.

Mobutu was driven from Princess Grace hospital to his French Riviera villa in Roquebrune-Cap Martin. His press service said he planned to return to Kinshasa by the end of the week to lead an attempt to quell the rebellion in eastern Zaire.
Photographers have been summoned to a photo session with the 66-year-old president on Thursday in an apparent effort to refute reports that he is seriously ill.
His private plane flew into Nice airport on Tuesday night and was standing by to fly him and his large entourage back to Zaire, but no date has been set for his departure yet, airport officials said.
